title: Example: C++ Native
tagline: An SKSE plugin that gives SkyrimNet C++ decorators, actions and event callbacks.
description:
The third SkyrimNet plugin example. ExampleNative.dll registers two decorators, a category of actions and a dialogue event callback through SkyrimNet's C++ API; this layer uses its decorators in a prompt.

**Requires:** ExampleNative.dll (shipped with this mod) and Address Library for SKSE Plugins.
author: example
